The '''J-7b beamdrill''' was a portable rifle sized [[Beamdrill/Legends|Beamdrill]] used extensively by the [[Corellia Mining Corporation/Legends|Corellia Mining Corporation]].

In service since before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the J-7b uses intense pulses of plasma to strip away rock, and was capable of carving through virtually anything - including armor. Because of its portability and cutting power, [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] were known to use the J-7b to breach the hulls and bulkheads of their prey vessels with the device.

While not intended to be used as a weapon, the J-7b could be used as such in a pinch, to deadly effect.
